summary: Inline r10/k3 predicates and price-bin downgrading align, but buy_special_filtered normalization does not reach either loss-rules predicate path, leaving NEW14 special-buy keys variant-sensitive.

issues.title: Filtered signal name misses loss-rule special-buy keys
issues.impact: buy_special_filtered passes the buy guard and inline normalization, but _ai_macro_hit_new_keys sends raw signal into rule_hit; specs with sig=buy_special miss. scripts/overfit_monitor.py:670 has the same raw context. This can suppress r2bSpecialGlobal/t1LowTurnSpecial in overview filters, consensus votes, email markers, and recent monitoring.
issues.evidence: Synthetic R2b: normalized=['r2bSpecialGlobal','t1LowTurnSpecial'], filtered=[]; monitor normalized includes both relevant keys, filtered=[]. rule_hit compares ctx.sig exactly at scripts/loss_rules.py:211.
issues.fix: Normalize once at a shared boundary and pass the canonical signal into _ai_macro_hit_new_keys and overfit recent_hit_keys' T1 context.

issues.title: Test coverage is narrower than its five-component claim
issues.impact: The test claims r10 five-component coverage but directly covers May, aux-Wednesday, and incidentally November-industry; it lacks isolated Monday and March-industry positives plus price-bin-only negatives. It also checks membership rather than exact expected sets despite describing exact-set assertions.
issues.evidence: Positive cases are at scripts/test_ai_macro_hit_filters.py:58-117; no bpb-only case exists.
issues.fix: Parameterize all implementable r10 components, assert exact sets with feature lookup stubbed, and add omitted-bpb negative samples.

issues.title: Unit test has an undeclared feature-file dependency
issues.impact: The docstring says no external data, but app.queries lazily reads static-site/data/kelly_loss_features.json during _ai_macro_hit_filters. Output can vary by checkout/data state; observed extra T1 keys in the passing run. No DB write or network side effect was found on import.
issues.evidence: scripts/test_ai_macro_hit_filters.py:30 imports full app.queries; app/queries.py:811-816 loads features and app/queries.py:957 invokes it during each positive test.
issues.fix: Stub or disable the module feature cache deterministically, or update the contract and assertions to account for feature-driven keys.

recommendation: Blocked until filtered-signal normalization reaches both loss_rules call paths and focused regression coverage is added.
